defects.description: The signed derivation entry takes parentContentHash from the hand-editable exhibits.content_hash mirror instead of the verified chain entry, so an edited mirror gets a valid signature over a parent hash no capture entry attests

Export-then-import of a Case with a deleted capture renumbers Exhibit 3 to 2 while the copied renumber entry still pins 3, and no corrective entry is written, contrary to the comment that an import cannot renumber
